verdict.rationale: Working Copy has AI features, so a data-retention and deletion control is a fair question for it. The pack only shows that AI features are opt-in and that suggestions send staged diffs to OpenAI. Nothing documents retention periods or deleting data sent to or held by the AI features. Opt-in consent is a related but different control, and git operations like Delete Commit rewrite repository history rather than govern data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
